corrections.text: The article quotes Sandesh Patnam, managing partner at Premji Invest, as saying "The progress we've seen since our initial investment has only deepened our conviction," attributed to SiliconANGLE. That quote does not appear in the cited SiliconANGLE report or any other cited source. The SiliconANGLE report contains no Patnam quote; the only sourced Patnam statement is from Upscale AI's January Series A announcement and reads differently: "Their ability to deliver proprietary-grade performance while embracing open standards reflects both strong technical conviction and real-world operating insight." The quoted sentence attributed to Patnam in this article should be treated as unverified.
